permutation_audit.convention: V'(k) = V(pi(k)); a position-tracking readout moves a signature at candidate d to pi_inv(d)

key_finding.statement: Under GT-weighted occupancy the two random permutations carry nearly identical expected band displacement (+4.15 vs +4.37) yet produced observed responses of opposite sign (-0.20 vs +1.98). The position-tracking band-bias model has no demonstrated predictive power over the random arm.
key_finding.consequence: Criterion 6 as implemented in both runs uses a single uncalibrated permutation with no null distribution and therefore has no established discriminative power in either direction.

reference_frame_caveat.statement: The band analysis maps GT/16 onto candidate index d. Both preregistrations forbid reinterpreting candidate indices as physical disparity, and both record an unresolved right-referenced/left-referenced discrepancy in the cost volume.
reference_frame_caveat.consequence: The GT-weighted numbers are DERIVED under an assumption both protocols reject and are admissible only as a design warning for the next experiment, never as a result.

jointly_confirmatory_findings.finding: The degenerate shift=none checkpoint's disparity_initial is bit-exactly invariant (0.0) under all four non-trivial candidate permutations, on all four scenes, in both runs.
For all three 6-block checkpoints, on 12/12 scene-checkpoint cases in both runs, d(+2) > d(+1) > d(0) > d(-1) holds, with responses of 1.09-2.97 candidates against a control that is exactly zero.
The two executions agree to four decimal places on every shared arm.

constraints_for_any_new_preregistration: Replace the single-draw scramble with an empirical permutation null; preregister the ordered arms' position within that null, with the threshold written into both the protocol and the code before any arm runs. Cost is negligible: 80 arms ran in 7.5-7.7 s with volumes cached.
Fix the mask or stop describing it as [2,8]: 99.4% of retained pixels lie in d in [2,4] and bins 6-8 are empty.
Measure spatial structure or delete it from the criterion; both runs preregistered a magnitude-and-structure conjunction and executed only magnitude.

Resolve or explicitly bracket the right-referenced/left-referenced discrepancy before any geometric diagnostic, since a correspondence experiment necessarily converts candidate indices to physical disparity.
Carry a RELATED_RUNS.md naming both existing executions so no future reader encounters either directory believing it is the only one.

closing_answer.question: Which experiment, if any, is the admissible basis for the next geometric correspondence diagnostic, and why?
closing_answer.answer: Neither run is admissible as a confirmatory basis, and no level-C result may be carried forward as established. The only admissible inheritance is the part of both records that was preregistered without a threshold, executed identically twice, and reproduces bit-exactly: the negative-control gate (degenerate shift=none readout invariant at 0.0 under every candidate permutation) and the ordered-arm response (d(+2) > d(+1) > d(0) > d(-1) on 12/12 scene-checkpoint cases across three seeds, agreeing to four decimal places across both executions). Those establish that the aggregation/readout path responds to candidate-axis re-indexing in an ordered, direction-consistent way; they do not establish that it tracks coordinate identity, because the control meant to separate ordered tracking from generic candidate-axis disturbance failed in both runs. The reason neither is confirmatory is the same in both cases and is not about chronology: the decisive criterion was never both preregistered and decidable. The next diagnostic must be preregistered fresh, must treat candidate-coordinate sensitivity as open rather than assume it as a premise, and must replace the random-permutation control with a calibrated null before any verdict language is written.
